About.metaDescription: IxMa Operations is a one-engineer practice run by Emilio Ramirez: scraping pipelines, document and vision models, data QA, and API integrations, handed off with full code ownership.
About.title: One engineer. No agency layers.
About.description: IxMa Operations is my practice — I'm Emilio Ramirez. I build scraping pipelines, document and vision models, data QA, and API integrations for individuals, small teams, and growing businesses. The person who scopes your project is the person who builds it.
About.storyTitle: Built because the usual options kept breaking
About.storyP1: Most automation work I saw fell into two camps: buried under agency layers where the person selling it never touched the code, or held together with no-code glue that broke the first time a source changed its layout.
About.storyP2: I started IxMa Operations to do it the other way. I build the pipeline once, test it against messy real data, and hand over the full codebase so it keeps running without me. You talk to me from the first email to the last commit.
About.philosophyDescription: I avoid fragile automations and agency overhead. Everything I deliver is meant to run deterministically in production, on your infrastructure.

deterministic.title: Deterministic & Production-Grade
deterministic.description: No brittle scripts or hallucinating prompts. I build verifiable pipelines with strict type validation, automated tests, and structured error handling.

direct.title: Direct Engineer Access
direct.description: You work with me, the engineer designing and building your system. Fast feedback loops, transparent scoping, and no account managers.

turnaround.title: Predictable & Fast Turnaround
turnaround.description: Scope is clear from day one, with typical delivery in 2–5 days for pre-scoped packages and clear milestones for custom architectures.

ownership.title: 100% Code & Asset Ownership
ownership.description: You own all code, trained weights, scripts, and documentation. Containerized and clean, designed to run on your infrastructure.

About.stackDescription: Proven, maintainable tools — nothing exotic that you'd struggle to hand to your own team later.
About.focusDescription: The technical areas where precision, speed, and accuracy create immediate operational leverage.

scraping.title: Web Extraction & Enrichment
scraping.description: Extracting structured data from complex sources with anti-bot resilience, schema validation, and intelligent entity enrichment.

ocr.title: Vision & Document Intelligence
ocr.description: Converting receipts, invoices, and legacy documents into structured data using fine-tuned OCR and layout-aware models.

workflow.title: Custom Backend Integrations
workflow.description: Bridging disparate APIs, databases, webhooks, and cron workers so your operations flow automatically without manual glue.

auditing.title: Data Auditing & Quality QA
auditing.description: Automated data health scoring, duplicate deduplication, format normalization, and rule-based validation at scale.

About.lifecycleDescription: Three steps from problem definition to working software in your hands.

step1.title: Intake & Spec
step1.description: You share the problem through the scoper or the brief form. I clarify schemas, edge cases, turnaround, and deliverables, and write them down as the spec.

step2.title: Engineering & Benchmark
step2.description: I build the pipeline or model and test it against real edge cases, noisy data, and performance benchmarks before you see it.

step3.title: Complete Codebase Handoff
step3.description: You receive the full codebase, environment configuration, and documentation, with direct support from me while you deploy.

About.founderBio: I'm a full-stack software and automation engineer focused on dependable data pipelines, applied machine learning and computer vision, and API architectures. I read every request myself, so the person who answers your first email is the one who writes the code.
About.ctaDescription: Tell me what you're trying to solve. I'll get back to you with real scope, timeline, and next steps.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: This policy explains what information IxMaOperations collects through this website, how it is used, and the choices you have. It is written in plain language on purpose.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: IxMaOperations is a contract automation and engineering practice operated by Emilio Ramirez. For anything in this policy, write to eramirez@ixmaoperations.com.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: Project requests: when you submit the project form or the estimator, we receive your name, email address, the description of your project, your timeline, an optional budget range and the estimator answers you chose. This is emailed to us and is not published anywhere.
Scheduling: when you book a meeting, we receive your name, email address, the time and format you chose (online or in person), an optional note, and the meeting location for in-person meetings.

Interactive demos: the document and image demos run inside your browser, and the files you choose are not uploaded to us. The web-scraper demo sends the web address you type to our server so it can fetch that public page; we do not store the address or the result.

Technical data: your IP address is used temporarily, for up to an hour, to limit abusive traffic, and our hosting provider keeps standard server logs. This site does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Google Calendar and Google user data
paragraphs: We use the Google Calendar API in two ways. First, to read the owner's own calendar so we only offer times that are actually free, and to create the calendar event (with a Google Meet link for online meetings) when a meeting is booked.

Second, if you choose Connect Google Calendar on the booking page, you grant read-only access to your free/busy information so we can show times that work for both of us. We read only the start and end times of your busy periods. We do not read event titles, descriptions, attendees or locations. Your access token is used once, in memory, to display the overlap; it is not stored, we do not request a refresh token, and the data is not shared, sold or used for advertising or to train AI models.
IxMaOperations' use and transfer of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
You can revoke access at any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions.

sections.heading: How we use information
paragraphs: We use your information to reply to your request, schedule and hold meetings, deliver agreed work, and protect the site from abuse. We do not sell your information and we do not use it for advertising.

sections.heading: Service providers
paragraphs: We rely on a small number of providers to run the site: Vercel (hosting), Resend (sending email), Supabase (database and sign-in for client accounts), Upstash (rate limiting) and Google (Calendar and Meet). They process data only to provide their service to us.

sections.heading: Client accounts
paragraphs: Accounts for the client area are created by us for existing clients; there is no public sign-up. In an account we keep your name, your sign-in email, the language and time zone you choose in Settings, and your email preferences, together with what you put in the portal: tickets, comments and files you attach. Text and files are stored encrypted.
What is in a client account is visible to you, to colleagues at your company whom we have given access (each one only to the project areas they can open), and to us.

We email you about your own tickets, for example when a fix is ready for you to check or when we reply. These emails contain the ticket's title and a link, never the message itself, and you can turn them off in Settings.

sections.heading: How long we keep information
paragraphs: Project request emails and meeting records are kept for as long as needed to respond to you, carry out any engagement, and meet our own record-keeping needs. We delete them sooner if you ask.
Client account information, including tickets and files, is kept while we work together and for as long afterwards as our own record-keeping needs require. We delete it sooner if you ask.

sections.heading: Security
paragraphs: Connections to this site are encrypted, access to stored data is restricted, and client data is separated per account. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your information.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us to show, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or to cancel a booking, by emailing eramirez@ixmaoperations.com. If you have a client account, you can change your name, language, time zone and email notifications yourself in Settings. This site is not directed at children under 18.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy, we will update the date at the top of this page. If a change affects how Google user data is handled, we will make that clear here.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These terms govern your use of this website and its scheduling feature. They do not replace the written agreement we sign for any paid project.

sections.heading: About this site
paragraphs: This site presents the services of IxMaOperations and lets you send a project request or book a meeting. Nothing here is a binding offer, quote or guarantee of availability. Project scope, price and delivery are set only in a written agreement between us.

sections.heading: Booking meetings
paragraphs: A meeting is confirmed when you receive a calendar invitation from us. In-person meetings take place at the location agreed with you and need at least 24 hours of notice. To cancel or reschedule, reply to the invitation or email eramirez@ixmaoperations.com. We may decline or reschedule a meeting if something unavoidable comes up, and we will tell you as early as we can.

sections.heading: Acceptable use
paragraphs: Do not misuse the site: no automated or bulk bookings, no attempts to overload, probe or bypass its protections, and no using the demos against sites you do not have the right to inspect. We may block access that looks abusive.

sections.heading: Demos
paragraphs: The interactive demos illustrate what we build. They are provided as is, may be inaccurate, and should not be relied on for real decisions or sensitive documents.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
